# Conditional same-contract comparator plan — not queued

**No winner exists in Gate4. Do not execute this plan now.** This is the comparator
qualification contract a genuinely new, separately registered direction would
need; it is not authorization for another campaign or a reinterpretation of the
three rejected hypotheses. No process budget is consumed or borrowed from old
campaigns.

## Panels and qualification

| Panel | Preferred comparator | Capability qualification before timing |
|---|---|---|
| CPU exact | PDX/PDX-BOND, BOND implementation, VA-file-style screen | Full-dataset exact search, not probed ANN; range API if available, otherwise explicitly labelled derived adapter with full output; same numeric boundaries |
| CPU exact | Faiss Flat and pinned FlatPanorama | k8/range complete outputs, native summation/tie differences, trained-transform costs if used, maintenance behavior |
| GPU exact | Strengthened B1 exhaustive scan and frozen Gate2 progressive scan | Rebuild both from the frozen source; exact ordered membership/fields, no query padding, all request/output/control costs |
| GPU exact external | Native Faiss/cuVS exhaustive kNN where qualified | Complete k8 with self matches/duplicates, numerical boundary/tie checks, allocations/norms/selection/query-transfer costs; do not assume range support |

CPU-only and GPU results have separate tables/estimators. **Never divide their
times to claim cross-device superiority.** An ANN IVF/CAGRA/PQ configuration is
not a same-quality exact comparator by giving it a high recall label.

Freeze N=1M,D960,FP32 input identity, original query sets/order, radius bits or k8,
coordinate/occurrence semantics and actual full outputs. Every system must satisfy
the ordered-oracle0FN/0FP target; a numeric adapter is disclosed and charged.
Do not repair a missed result by silently changing query/radius/recall thresholds.

For a dynamic claim use the entire unchanged original A trace and later admitted
update-heavy/long traces, not only an initial snapshot or a modified mix. Include
append/delete acknowledgements, live occurrence mapping, norm/aux updates,
reorganization/deferred compaction and capacity growth when exercised. Preserve
all correctness and final-vector checks. Building/training and steady query
timing remain separate, both charged for the appropriate claim.

## Measurement boundary and admission

Declare full Host-ready per-query timing including preparation, H2D, all distance,
selection/refinement/compaction/count waits, full D2H answers and mapping. For a
joint service, choose one identical events+release/resource boundary and disclose
all excluded audit/serialization/Host cleanup time. Do not silently inherit the
broader wording of Gate3's timer; use its documented actual boundary or register
a newly equal boundary. Freeze same-hardware/software/clocks state and repeat the
same-panel comparator in direction-balanced processes under a single GPU lock.

Only a novel exact candidate with measured same-contract external advantage can
promote: >=1.5x query, >=5x lower charged maintenance, >=2x smaller auxiliary
representation, or >=1.3x joint E2E, with correctness and declared uncertainty
gates. No kernel-only/internal10% gain or platform multiplier substitutes.

This document establishes comparison requirements, not comparator correctness,
installed availability, a binary, a timing result or permission to start a job.
